transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I just don’t see things getting better anymore, no matter what I do. It feels like I'm just spinning my wheels every day, and nothing I try seems to make a difference.

Have you had other periods in your life, lasting at least a couple of weeks, when you felt this same kind of depression before now? Or did these feelings start mainly after a specific stressful event or major change?

No, I haven't really had times like this in the past. This all started about two years ago during a slow stretch in the construction market when I decided to open my own furniture studio, and it’s just been one long, continuous drag since then.

Do your low mood and worry feel mainly tied to the ongoing stress from your furniture business, or do they continue just as strongly even when that stress is less intense? Also, have you had severe depression symptoms like losing interest in almost everything, feeling worthless, or thinking about death?

Even when a job goes well, this heavy mood doesn't lift, and I've completely lost interest in things I used to love, like hiking and playing guitar. I constantly feel like I'm just not good enough and that I'm a failure, though I don't have any thoughts of hurting myself or death.

How much is this depression affecting your day-to-day functioning—for example, are you still able to keep up with work, self-care, and basic responsibilities, or has it become very hard to manage them?

It’s become incredibly hard to manage my daily life, and I feel like I’m just dragging myself through each day. I've started turning down demanding custom jobs, putting off invoices and emails, and avoiding invitations from my friends. Because of that, both my income and my social life have thinned out a lot.
During these past two years, have there been stretches of at least 2 months when you felt mostly back to your usual self, or has the depression been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, there haven't been any breaks like that. This heavy, stuck feeling has been there pretty much nonstop, nearly every single day for the whole two years. I haven't had even a week or two where I felt back to my usual self.

opening_question.question: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a chronic depressed mood lasting nearly every day for 2 years without remission of 2 months or more, beginning after a business-related stressor but persisting independently of stress intensity. Functional impairment is significant. Although severe depressive symptoms are present (anhedonia, worthlessness, marked impairment), the course is continuous and chronic rather than a discrete major depressive episode, supporting persistent mood disorder/dysthymia over a single severe depressive episode.
